open_points.subject: latest_pointer_of_type
open_points.text: - latest_pointer_of_type: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST first answer a Refusal with the NOT_FOUND member of = models.RefusalCode at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_EXISTENCE constant names and one failure of the UNKNOWN_PROJECT member of = models.RefusalKind, its path naming the project_id input, when validate_project_reference answers that project_id does not exist, and then a Refusal with the INVALID_REQUEST member at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_VALUES constant names and one failure of the UNKNOWN_ARTIFACT_TYPE member, its path naming the artifact_type input, when artifact_type is None or _owner_service_of_type answers None for it, a removed type refused even when pointers of it remain.
open_points.other_text: Only import runtime model symbols from app.models when they are explicitly listed in IMPORTS.
open_points.question: Either PathElement must be added to IMPORTS so the required RefusalFailure.path values can be constructed with their declared type, or the note must require an available imported constructor for those path values.

open_points.subject: list_pointers
open_points.text: - list_pointers: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST answer a Refusal with the NOT_FOUND member of = models.RefusalCode at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_EXISTENCE constant names and one failure of the UNKNOWN_PROJECT member of = models.RefusalKind, its path naming the project_id input, when validate_project_reference answers that project_id does not exist; an archived or anonymised project MUST be listed as any other.
open_points.other_text: Only import runtime model symbols from app.models when they are explicitly listed in IMPORTS.
open_points.question: Either PathElement must be added to IMPORTS so the required RefusalFailure.path value can be constructed with its declared type, or the note must require an available imported constructor for that path value.

open_points.subject: publish_pointer
open_points.text: - publish_pointer: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST check in stage order and answer only the first failing stage, as a Refusal carrying every failure of that stage: first a Refusal with the NOT_FOUND member of = models.RefusalCode at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_EXISTENCE constant names and one failure of the UNKNOWN_PROJECT member of = models.RefusalKind, its path naming the project_id input, when validate_project_reference answers that project_id does not exist; then a Refusal with the INVALID_REQUEST member at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_VALUES constant names.
open_points.other_text: Only import runtime model symbols from app.models when they are explicitly listed in IMPORTS.
open_points.question: Either PathElement must be added to IMPORTS so the required RefusalFailure.path value can be constructed with its declared type, or the note must require an available imported constructor for that path value.

open_points.subject: publish_pointer
open_points.text: - publish_pointer: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST collect the failures of the values stage as follows, ordered by kind as the RefusalKind members MISSING_VALUE then MALFORMED_REQUEST_ID then UNKNOWN_ARTIFACT_TYPE and within one kind by path, each path, for a field of = models.GivenPointer, an element holding the name pointer of the input that holds it followed by one holding the field's name, and for request_id one holding request_id: the failure read_required_text answers for the given artifact type; the UNKNOWN_ARTIFACT_TYPE failure when that type is present but _owner_service_of_type answers None for it; one MISSING_VALUE failure for each of the two reference fields of GivenPointer when read_optional_text answers None for both; and the failure check_request_id_form answers for request_id.
open_points.other_text: Only import runtime model symbols from app.models when they are explicitly listed in IMPORTS.
open_points.question: Either PathElement must be added to IMPORTS so the required one- and two-element RefusalFailure.path tuples can be constructed with their declared element type, or the note must require an available imported constructor for those paths.

open_points.subject: publish_pointer
open_points.text: - publish_pointer: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST answer a Refusal with the REFUSED member of = models.RefusalCode at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_LIFECYCLE constant names, changing nothing, carrying a failure of the ARCHIVED member of = models.RefusalKind with its path naming the project_id input when validate_project_reference answers the project not active, an anonymised one included, and after it a failure of the CONFLICT member with its path naming the request_id input when a pointer of the project carries the request id and facts_equal_for_repeat answers false.
open_points.other_text: Only import runtime model symbols from app.models when they are explicitly listed in IMPORTS.
open_points.question: Either PathElement must be added to IMPORTS so the required RefusalFailure.path values can be constructed with their declared type, or the note must require an available imported constructor for those path values.

open_points.subject: withdraw_pointer
open_points.text: - withdraw_pointer: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST check in stage order and answer only the first failing stage, as a Refusal carrying every failure of that stage, each path naming the pointer_id input: a Refusal with the NOT_FOUND member of = models.RefusalCode at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_EXISTENCE constant names and one failure of the UNKNOWN_POINTER member of = models.RefusalKind when load_pointer finds no pointer of pointer_id; then one with the INVALID_REQUEST member at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_VALUES constant names and one failure of the UNKNOWN_ARTIFACT_TYPE member when _owner_service_of_type answers None for the pointer's type; then one with the REFUSED member at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_LIFECYCLE constant names carrying, in this order, a failure of the WITHDRAWN member when the pointer is withdrawn, of the SUPERSEDED member when it is superseded, and of the ARCHIVED member when validate_project_reference answers its project not active.
open_points.other_text: Only import runtime model symbols from app.models when they are explicitly listed in IMPORTS.
open_points.question: Either PathElement must be added to IMPORTS so the required RefusalFailure.path values can be constructed with their declared type, or the note must require an available imported constructor for those path values.

open_points.subject: _owner_service_of_type
open_points.text: - _owner_service_of_type: [TEST_EVIDENCE] A test MUST show that the imported ARTIFACT_TYPE_OWNERS constant of this release holds exactly one row, the estimate type owned by the PRESUPRO member of = models.ServiceName, that _owner_service_of_type answers that member for it and None for every other type, and that a type is compared exactly as written.
open_points.rule:
- Inline-данные: таблицы соответствий, allow-lists, пороги, TTL, пути, рейтинги, размеры, словари alias'ов. Значение размещается процедурой 15.2 и доходит до кода одним из трёх путей §15.3.1; note называет
  перечисление адресом `= models.SomeStatus` (член — его именем рядом с адресом, §15.3.1),
  константу — именем импортируемого символа
  (`the imported RETRY_LIMIT constant`), настройку — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: The note must stop stating the constant's one-row artifact-type-to-service mapping inline and refer only to the imported ARTIFACT_TYPE_OWNERS constant; the exact mapping must remain solely in its data-provider declaration.

open_points.subject: _owner_service_of_type
open_points.text: - _owner_service_of_type: [TEST_EVIDENCE] A test MUST show that the imported ARTIFACT_TYPE_OWNERS constant of this release holds exactly one row, the estimate type owned by the PRESUPRO member of = models.ServiceName, that _owner_service_of_type answers that member for it and None for every other type, and that a type is compared exactly as written.
open_points.rule:
- **Модель не видит значений.** В контекст модуля подаётся сигнатура доступа —
  имя модуля-носителя, имя символа и его тип, — но не значение. Блок данных
  является обычным provider-модулем; доступ к нему объявляется ребром
  `module_internal` наравне с любой другой зависимостью (§7). Закрытая форма
  provider-модуля — §6.10, модуля настроек запуска — §6.11; какой путь
  принадлежит какому значению — §15.3.1.
open_points.question: The note must name ARTIFACT_TYPE_OWNERS and its type without revealing that constant's row count or artifact-type-to-owner value.
